verdict.summary: The exact OP7-to-OP6-to-OP5-to-OP2 projection, object-identical EventEnvelopeV3 semantic slice, predecessor rejection binding, and authenticated-buffer dependency execution all pass independent reconstruction and falsification. The package is nevertheless rejected for two totality defects in the exact v7 checker. A JSON-valid 4,301-digit integer, only 4,302 raw bytes and below every declared raw/depth/node/container/string bound, escapes the CLI as an uncaught Python ValueError traceback on the review runtime. Separately, a list or object in bindingFixtures[*].kind reaches set membership before type validation; the outer wrapper converts each TypeError into OP7-TOTALITY-INTERNAL, and the authored selftest incorrectly accepts that internal-exception class merely because the finding list is nonempty. Both behaviors contradict the candidate's declared validate-before-set/hash and no-exception totality rules.

blockingFindings.title: A bounded JSON-valid integer escapes the CLI as an uncaught runtime-dependent ValueError
blockingFindings.requirementViolated: closedShapeDeclarations.jsonInputBounds plus totalityRule require every bounded JSON scalar shape to produce named findings and never an exception.
evidence: A 4,300-digit root integer returns a controlled OP7-TOTALITY finding.
A 4,301-digit root integer is only 4,302 bytes but produces a traceback from CPython's default integer-string conversion limit.
A 5,000-digit root integer behaves the same under the default limit and becomes controlled when PYTHONINTMAXSTRDIGITS=0, proving environment-dependent behavior outside the contract.
main catches JSONDecodeError, DuplicateKeyError, InputLimitError, RecursionError, and UnicodeError, but not the generic ValueError raised by integer conversion.
blockingFindings.impact: The exact candidate/checker pair does not close the rejected predecessor's malformed-input totality class. Review automation can emit a traceback rather than a deterministic named finding for a valid input inside every declared resource bound.
requiredRepair: Define a closed, deterministic numeric-token policy, including explicit token-length and finite/range behavior where relevant.
Use json parse_int, parse_float, and parse_constant callbacks, or an equivalent byte-level numeric-token gate, so implementation/runtime conversion limits cannot escape the declared contract.
Convert every numeric parse refusal into a named controlled finding at the CLI boundary; do not rely on PYTHONINTMAXSTRDIGITS or another ambient runtime setting.

Add 4,301-digit and 5,000-digit integer controls, large negative integers, large fraction/exponent controls, and nonfinite constants to both API/CLI tests. Require exact named invariants and zero traceback/internal-exception outcomes.

blockingFindings.title: bindingFixtures kind is hashed by set membership before its type is validated
blockingFindings.requirementViolated: closedShapeDeclarations.totalityRule explicitly requires every consumed member to be validated before set construction, hash lookup, or indexing.
evidence: Replacing any bindingFixtures[*].kind with [] yields OP7-TOTALITY-INTERNAL from an unhashable list.
Replacing any bindingFixtures[*].kind with {} yields OP7-TOTALITY-INTERNAL from an unhashable dict.
The result reproduces for all eight fixture rows, 16 cases total.
The authored systematic selftest includes these replacements but considers any nonempty finding list a pass, so it treats a caught internal TypeError as evidence of correct validation.
blockingFindings.impact: Although the outer check wrapper prevents these TypeErrors from escaping the API, the checker violates its own validation-order guarantee, discards the more specific shape finding, and has an oracle that cannot distinguish intended rejection from an internal checker exception.
requiredRepair: Validate fixture.kind as a string before closed-vocabulary membership, then return a specific OP7-SHAPE finding for every non-string or out-of-vocabulary value.
Make OP7-TOTALITY-INTERNAL and every traceback/exception class forbidden outcomes in normal checks and selftests, not accepted rejection evidence.
For every malformed vector, require the expected named invariant and assert zero internal/exception-class findings; failure-to-apply and unexpected-finding-only cases must count as escapes.
Retain exhaustive list/object substitutions at all eight kind positions and independently rereview the replacement exact bytes.

requiredSuccessorConditions: Preserve operability.v7.json and this rejection review byte-identically; do not silently edit the rejected pair.
Produce a narrow successor whose projection preserves the exact v7-to-v6-to-v5-to-v2 semantic chain.
Close both numeric parser and fixture-kind validation-order findings in code and binding declarations.
Change the selftest oracle from any-finding-is-success to expected-named-invariant plus zero OP7-TOTALITY-INTERNAL, traceback, or exception-class outcomes.
Obtain a fresh independent review of the complete replacement bytes before integration, application, promotion, or seal.
